name: Why should appliances be installed by a remodeling contractor rather than standard retail delivery crews?

mainEntity.name: Why should appliances be installed by a remodeling contractor rather than standard retail delivery crews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional installation by a general contracting team ensures that all manufacturer-specified clearances, dedicated utility connections, and warranty criteria are strictly met. Complex units like dishwashers, gas cooktops, and built-in refrigerators risk costly water leaks, gas hazards, or electrical overloads if connected improperly. Furthermore, our project managers coordinate appliance placement alongside custom cabinet trim, countertop backsplashes, and under-cabinet lighting, resolving small fit issues immediately and protecting surrounding newly remodeled finishes from incidental damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remodeling contractor coordinates licensed trades, fits custom panels and trim, verifies warranty clearances, and protects your newly finished cabinets and floors.
